comparison.objective: Insert an oversized cabinet shelf through a narrow opening and place it on four pins.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual rigid-panel rotation, clearance management, leveling and support placement.
comparison.success_condition: Shelf on all pins, level, square, pushed home and released for 1 s. No material rubric detail missing.
comparison.reason: Shares careful bimanual reseating, but its tested ability is configuration-space manipulation of one rigid panel, not loose-body separation and retention.
